sampling_limitations: 40 selected review/theme pairs from one establishment, non-representative of all stored reviews or independent restaurants.
References are GPT-6 model judgments, not human annotations.

The theme was visible; two candidate polarities (positions 1 and 2) were exposed during administrative source inspection before this adjudication. Remaining proposed polarities and model decisions were not retrieved while annotating.
Resolved English texts were used; no independent source-language translation validation.
V3 must be evaluated in a separate later step after this file is frozen; no V3 reference labels or historical predictions were modified.
Uncertain decisions must be excluded from binary precision/recall calculations or reported separately.

definitions.decisive_coverage: supported_by_rule or unsupported_by_rule, divided by all or comparable cases as labelled
definitions.selective_agreement: correct accepts plus correct rejections / decisive comparable cases; abstentions excluded
definitions.strict_agreement: correct accepts plus correct rejections / all comparable cases; abstentions not counted as agreement
definitions.unjustified_acceptance_rate: incorrect accepts / accepted comparable associations; not global JEV precision
definitions.jev_baseline: selected JEV associations, not all 25-theme predictions; no absent-theme accuracy inferred

cases.analysis_text: Do not miss this!! Highly recommend this place for drinks or food! Go inside and see for yourself! From the outside doesn’t look like much but do yourself a favour!
cases.reference_justification: Appearance from outside is unassuming, but there is no evaluation of the restaurant's location, distance or access.

cases.analysis_text: Delicious. The cozy dining room doesn't look particularly impressive at first glance, but once inside, you feel cozy and comfortable. Greenery, beautiful interior details.
cases.reference_justification: Interior/decor is initially described as unimpressive, then greenery and beautiful interior details are praised.

cases.analysis_text: The place is quite spacious. However, the service was disappointing. A staff member handed me the menu and said he would return in five minutes, but after 15 minutes, I had to go downstairs myself to place my order. The drinks were also underwhelming for the price and definitely not worth it.
cases.reference_justification: Employee promised five minutes but did not return after fifteen; the guest had to go downstairs to order.

cases.analysis_text: The female employee at this shop had a bad attitude towards foreign customers. I'm Vietnamese, and I brought my friends here to buy something, and my friends are foreigners.
cases.reference_justification: The employee's discriminatory or poor attitude toward foreign customers is explicit unprofessional conduct.

cases.analysis_text:
The portions are already incredibly small.
But I can't remember how many times I've failed to enjoy my meal here. The drinks are excellent. The food is completely tasteless. The coffee and drinks arrived early, and we waited for the food. The coffee got cold while it was still being served. Very disappointed.
cases.reference_justification: Food arrived sufficiently late after drinks that the coffee grew cold while waiting.

statement.quote: the service is a little slow.

cases.analysis_text: Artisan Cafe & Eatery is a great place to visit if you want a change of pace with brunch in Nha Trang. The cozy atmosphere and rustic decor are quite relaxing. The food is delicious and beautifully presented, but the service is a little slow. The cafe also has many photogenic spots. Prices are reasonable, but the menu could probably be more diverse. Overall, it's good!
cases.reference_justification: The review explicitly says service is a little slow.

excerpt.quote: the service is a little slow.

cases.analysis_text: The presentation is 5 stars. It looks beautiful, but the taste is strange. Everything is mixed together. It's a typical salmon scramble with toast, but in your mouth you taste cinnamon, sugar, something spicy, flowers, and pumpkin jam. There's nothing to spread on the toast, so it's very dry... not for everyone. The pasta Bolognese is just ordinary. The bill was 450,000, although it should have been 400,000 (they probably add a service charge). Not worth the money.
cases.reference_justification: The bill exceeded the expected amount and a possibly unannounced service charge was suspected.

cases.analysis_text: Delicious food and friendly service. Prices are a little higher than the local average, but it's worth it.
cases.reference_justification: Higher-than-local-average prices are explicitly stated, but immediately judged worthwhile; a negative price-level attitude is not clear.

cases.analysis_text: A fantastic place, a 7-minute taxi ride from Nha Trang city center for 100 rubles. The food is beyond reproach; we tried all the pastas, salads, and lasagna. The flavors and combinations are superb. Free seating is available in the evening, so no waiting. There's definitely no other place like this in Nha Trang with cuisine like this, and we highly recommend everyone try it at least once. The prices are above average, but it's worth it. The portions are generous and large.
cases.reference_justification: Above-average prices are explicitly described as worth the experience, establishing positive value for money.

cases.analysis_text: A very tasty establishment! The prices are closer to Moscow's, of course, but the dishes are very high-quality and delicious.
cases.reference_justification: A price comparison with Moscow alone does not state whether the price level is positively or negatively judged.

cases.analysis_text: Tax (     It’s simply a matter of including it in the base price )
cases.reference_justification: Criticizes tax being separated rather than included in the base price, an explicit billing-transparency issue.

cases.analysis_text: Perfect place. One of the most beautiful restaurants I visited in Vietnam. Perfect breakfast for the whole family that includes everything. And not expensive. Many thanks to Artisan!
cases.reference_justification: A complete family breakfast is praised as perfect and not expensive, indicating a favorable price-to-offering judgment.

statement.quote: The prices were quite reasonable for the portions,

cases.analysis_text: I ordered an egg royal and an artisan salmon, but they weren't as good as I expected. The poached eggs were overcooked; the yolks of both were dry when cut open. The salmon wasn't very fresh. The prices were quite reasonable for the portions, but the quality was only acceptable. However, the restaurant's atmosphere was nice, cool, and quiet.
cases.reference_justification: Prices are explicitly called reasonable for the portions.

cases.analysis_text: It was very surprising to find this place in the middle of a residential street area, the prices are pleasant, the atmosphere is very attractive and the carp pool at the entrance is very beautiful. I recommend everyone to visit this place.
cases.reference_justification: Pleasant prices are praised without an explicit comparison between price and the service or product obtained.

cases.analysis_text: A very atmospheric place with delicious coffee and breakfasts! The prices are affordable, I recommend it!
cases.reference_justification: Affordable prices and delicious food are both mentioned, but no definite value-for-money comparison is made.

cases.analysis_text: A very atmospheric place! We're from Russia, visiting Nha Trang for the first time. We found out about this restaurant on Instagram. It's very beautiful, delicious, and inexpensive! Definitely worth a visit!
cases.reference_justification: Explicitly describes the experience as beautiful, delicious and inexpensive together, suggesting favorable value.

cases.analysis_text:
There's unslaked baking soda in the pancake.
Bad.

statement.quote: since it's a cafe, the food overall isn't that great.

cases.analysis_text: The atmosphere is okay, but since it's a cafe, the food overall isn't that great. If you want to eat, go to a restaurant.
cases.reference_justification: The review says the food overall is not great.

cases.analysis_text:
An excellent restaurant in every way. We spent around 610,000 dong here.

We ordered three full dishes (the portions were huge, we even regretted ordering two). They give you water when you sit down, but I'm not sure where it comes from.

The waiters were super nice, everything was brought quickly, and they were very attentive even though we arrived just before closing time.

The signature smoothies are beyond praise. If we were staying here instead of visiting on a tourist trip, we would come here regularly.
cases.reference_justification: Large, generous portions are highlighted favorably; having ordered too many dishes is not a criticism of the portion itself.

cases.analysis_text:
We went to this place last night. The prices are steep, and the burgers aren't big.
The menu says the dishes are exempt from 8 percent VAT, plus a 2 percent service charge.
The menu description is unclear.
cases.reference_justification: The burgers are described as not big, explicitly criticizing serving quantity.

cases.analysis_text:
Delicious and beautiful.
The only thing is, there's very little feta in the protein bowl. But the portion is good and it's delicious.
cases.reference_justification: The protein bowl's portion is described as good, but its feta quantity as too little.

cases.analysis_text: Nice place and service.
cases.reference_justification: Generic praise for service does not describe service organization or coordination.

cases.analysis_text:
Absolutely fantastic place, if you are looking for a bit more "western" food, English breakfasts and so on. Simple menu, very good coffee also.
The atmosphere is really pleasant, original and the guys working there are so polite and cool. Top spot!
cases.reference_justification: Employees are explicitly described as polite, which is a positive friendliness/politeness judgment.

cases.analysis_text:
The place has a great atmosphere. We had shrimp pasta, and the shrimp were soft and tender, not rubbery. The burgers were also very tasty and juicy. I liked the chicken one best, but that's a matter of taste. The burgers come with fries.
The service is good; the waiters are attentive and don't overwhelm you.
I recommend ordering one of the dishes, as the portions are large and filling, but they can also pack takeaway if you need something.
cases.reference_justification: Attentive servers and generally good service do not by themselves establish organization or synchronization.

cases.analysis_text: The Artisan Cafe a must to experience if you are in Nha Trang. The staff there is friendly courteous and their customer service is impeccable. The atmosphere is vibrant and calming and stunning. Food is just as perfect with a diverse variety of menu options to choose from. Will be visiting again very soon! (The photo depicts their protein bowl paired with their blueberry galaxy smoothie).
cases.reference_justification: Impeccable customer service is generic praise without any specific attention-to-needs action.

cases.analysis_text: Delicious food! Pleasant atmosphere and attentive staff. We'll definitely be back again 💜
cases.reference_justification: Attentive staff are mentioned but not explicit knowledge, competence or professional handling.

cases.analysis_text: Nice placeee😍😍 Interior is amazing, cozy chill vibe, food is delicious. I really recommend the protein bowl. Thank you✨✨
cases.reference_justification: A cozy, chill vibe is a direct positive evaluation of atmosphere.

cases.analysis_text: This was the first place we went to eat after arriving in Nha Trang. We went there several times during our vacation. And we're finishing our Vietnam trip with dinner here. It's such a beautiful place, from the entrance to the food to the faucet in the restroom. The coffee is delicious, as were all the dishes we tried. The staff is wonderful and always smiling. Thank you ❤️

cases.analysis_text: Beautiful and quiet place, polite staff and delicious food

cases.analysis_text: This is an absolutely standout, incredible place for brunch (or any other meal for that matter). Flavours are delicious, fresh and wholesome and the dishes are vibrant and creative. We discovered the cafe in our last week in Vietnam, returned the next day and if we weren’t leaving tomorrow, we’d be back again! Everything we tried was excellent but perhaps the real highlights were the hummus eggs, protein bowl, beef shakshuka and pancakes.
cases.reference_justification: Vibrant, creative dishes may reflect appearance, but no clear evaluation of their visual plating/presentation is given.

cases.analysis_text:
The entrance is very beautiful, it sets the atmosphere even before you enter the cafe. And the food is incredibly delicious ❤️
The staff is welcoming and friendly, which is also wonderful.
cases.reference_justification: The food is explicitly described as incredibly delicious.

cases.analysis_text: Everything was delicious, the staff was polite, they could explain everything and translate if something was not clear, special 5 stars for the croissant with chocolate😍😍

cases.analysis_text: Very tasty and a relaxed atmosphere. It feels like a Balinese place, the same vibe. I recommend it 👍
cases.reference_justification: The review says very tasty in a restaurant context, conveying positive food taste.

cases.analysis_text: We visited this restaurant on September 9, 2026. We experienced aesthetic pleasure! Gustatory ecstasy! The cuisine was mind-blowing. Special respect to the chef! We recommend visiting! The atmosphere is European.

cases.analysis_text: Lasagna and smoothies are magical❤️
